spans.s: नडः [naḍḥ] डम् [ḍam], डम् A species of reed.
डः N. of a prince with patronymic Naiṣadha (= नलनैषध); see नल.

N. of a tribe preparing a sort of bracelets. -Comp. -अगारम्, -आगारम् a hut of reeds. -नेरिः a kind of dance. -प्राय a. abounding in reeds. -भक्तम् a place abounding in reeds. -मीनः a kind of fish (sprat).-वनम् a thicket of reeds. -संहतिः f. a collection or quantity of reeds.
नडकम् [naḍakam], 1 A bone between the shoulders; 'हृदयं जिह्वा क्रोडं सव्यसक्थि पूर्वनडकम्', 'दक्षिणसक्थि पूर्वनडकम्' Kāty.
नडश [naḍaśa], a. (-शी f.) Covered with reeds; (also नडकीय).
नडह [naḍaha], a. Beautiful, lovely; see लडह.
A reed-bed, a river abounding in reeds.
नडिल [naḍila], a., नड्वत् a. (-ती f.) Abounding in or covered with reeds, reedy.
लम्, ला A quantity or a bed of reeds; बलानि संममर्दाशु नड्वलानीव कुञ्जरः
A place abounding in reeds or grass; नागः प्रभिन्न इव नड्वलेषु
The tubular stalk of any plant.
The hollow stalk of a lotus &c.; स इत्थमुद्वीक्ष्य तदब्द- नालनाडीभिरन्तर्जलमाविवेश
Any tubular organ of the body (such as an artery, vein); ष़डधिकदशनाडीचक्रमध्यस्थितात्मा
The pulse at the hand or foot.
A measure of time equal to twenty-four minutes.

A weaver's implement; L. D. B. -Comp. -चक्रम् a group of tubular organs of the body such as: मूलाधार, स्वाधिष्ठान, मणिपुर, अनाहत, विशुद्धि, आज्ञाचक्र, सहस्राधार; Pātañjala; ष़डधिकदशनाडीचक्मध्यस्थितात्मा,
a tube round which the woof is wound.
a kind of crane; नाडीजङ्घो निजघ्ने कृततदुपकृतिर्यत्कृते गौतमेन

a debaucher, ravisher. -नक्षत्रम् = जन्मनक्षत्र q. v. -परीक्षा feeling the pulse. -पात्रम् a kind of water-clock. -मण्डलम् the celestial equator. -यन्त्रम् any tubular instrument.-वलयम् equinoctical circle. -व्रणः sinus, an ulcer, a fistula. -स्वेदः steam-bath through tubes.
नाडिका [nāḍikā], 1 A tubular organ &c.; see नाडि.
A gong (on which the hours are struck).
नाडिं [nāḍi] डीं [ḍī] धम [dhama], (डीं) धम a. Causing a movement of the tubular organs (as fright &c.); नाडिंधमेन श्वासेन
नाडिंधय [nāḍindhaya], a. Drinking or sucking through a tube.
